node_definition.done_when: Done when. A test runs one station tick over 50 fixture terminal runs whose run files are absent, so every lookup reads the index rather than a run file, with a ledger write made after the first lookup so the index is stale for the rest of the tick; it counts at most one rebuild across the tick. A second test, in the same stale state, makes a lookup after the tick's one rebuild has completed and reads it answered from that rebuilt index with no further rebuild and no write transaction. A third test holds a rebuild open in a second process and reads a lookup answered from the last complete index without waiting. A negative control that rebuilds on every stale lookup counts more than one rebuild in the first test. The gate runs on all_debug and its log is written to the section's evidence fragment.
node_definition.goal: The open-run index is rebuilt at most once per pass, and a lookup against a current index writes nothing
